# load_valid_flows { #timetoalign.timelines.load_valid_flows }

```python
timelines.load_valid_flows(csv_path)
```

Load all valid flows from a .flow.csv file, grouped by flow_mode.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type            | Description                 | Default    |
|----------|-----------------|-----------------------------|------------|
| csv_path | \'Path \| str\' | Path to the .flow.csv file. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                      | Description                                                         |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[FlowMode](`timetoalign.core.enums.FlowMode`), \'Flow\'\] | Dict mapping FlowMode to Flow for each unique flow_mode in the CSV. |
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[FlowMode](`timetoalign.core.enums.FlowMode`), \'Flow\'\] | Skips unknown flow_modes and ERROR entries.                         |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> flows = load_valid_flows(Path("tests/data/target_flows/specimen.flow.csv"))
>>> default_flow = flows[FlowMode.default]
>>> for mode, flow in flows.items():
...     print(f"{mode.value}: {len(flow.sections)} sections")
```
